title: Qullan Utan Paciencia Almapa
intro: Quran pankanakanx mä jach’a profetan lineamientopat mä chimpuw uñsti, chuymankipstañanx mä regalo ukham churatawa. Aka almax jan mayjt’ir chiqaw satap laykuw jach’añchasi, ukat mä santuario utt’ayañanx wali jach’a lurawimpiw jach’añchasi, ukax iyawsäwin mä qhanpach tukuñapänwa. Uka pʼeqeñchäwinak liytʼkasajj nayra tiempon arup sum istʼañamawa, kunattejj nayrïr jaqenwa parli.
clues: Nayax Quran qillqatanx yaqha profetamp chikaw arsutätxa, mä chuyman yatiyirir churat regalo ukhama.
Nayajj uka profetar qhepa maranakan churat pä wawanakat maynïrïtwa.
Nayax Quran qillqatanx jach’añchataw uñjasta, arunakajarjam chiqapar sarnaqatajata.
Nayax profetjam jach’añchäwi apt’asiwayta ukat mä yatiyirit khithatätwa.
Nayax tatajamp chikaw Sagrado Utan cimientonakap jach’anchayta.
Paciencianinakat maynïritwa amtasitu, ukat lurapkta uka qullan utax jaqinakan kuttʼaniñapataki ukat jan kuna jan waltʼäwin uñjasiñapatakiw tukuwayi.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
